title: Yakima County bigfoot hunt offers families free fun and prizes
excerpt: Yakima, Wash. — A countywide Bigfoot hunt in Yakima is giving families a reason to head outside and search for hidden figurines.
content:
Yakima, Wash. — A countywide Bigfoot hunt in Yakima is giving families a reason to head outside and search for hidden figurines.

The Greater Yakima Chamber of Commerce put the event together as a family activity that gets people working together to look for small Sasquatch figures. Kristi Foster, president and CEO of the Greater Yakima Chamber of Commerce, said she was glad to bring something different to the area.

“I think it really has brought a lot of fun to Yakima. And, you know, maybe there's not as many things to do right now, so it's something that people can do with their family, with their kids, just something different,” Foster said.

Clues as to where the hidden bigfoot figurines are, can be found on the Yakima Chamber of Commerce social media pages. People who find a figure can turn it in at their office for a ticket to Bigfoot Con and an entry into the VIP raffle.

Bigfoot Con is set for October 23 at the Valley Mall and October 24 at Legends Casino. People could expect an appearance from the cast of Finding Bigfoot at the event.

People who do not find one of the hidden figures can still get tickets to Bigfoot Con before the event.
